capabilities.name: Automatic Switchboard Synthesis
capabilities.intent: Generate validated switchboard variants from finalized circuits, protection requirements, phase constraints, reserve policy and physical enclosure constraints.

capabilities.name: Project Autopilot
capabilities.intent: Generate candidate electrical distribution architectures from loads, locations, sources, criticality and engineering policies.

capabilities.name: Engineering Audit + Auto-Fix
capabilities.intent: Generate validated remediation alternatives for engineering findings and simulate their project-wide consequences before acceptance.

capabilities.name: Failure X-Ray
capabilities.intent: Show deterministic downstream functional and electrical consequences of failure of any selected source, board, breaker, feeder, cable or critical asset.

capabilities.name: Revision Impact Intelligence
capabilities.intent: Explain engineering consequences of project edits and revision changes rather than only structural/database differences.

capabilities.name: Multi-Objective Design Optimizer
capabilities.intent: Search valid alternatives and expose Pareto trade-offs across cost, size, losses, reserve, reliability, maintainability and other declared objectives.

capabilities.name: Critical Power Simulator
capabilities.intent: Simulate deterministic time-ordered normal/emergency power behavior for grid loss, generator start, ATS transfer, UPS ride-through and load shedding.

capabilities.name: As-Built / Commissioning Twin
capabilities.intent: Track and validate DESIGNED, INSTALLED, VERIFIED and COMMISSIONED states in the same project model.

capabilities.name: Vendor-Neutral Equipment Optimizer
capabilities.intent: Derive engineering requirements first, then rank technically valid manufacturer/SKU candidates independently of vendor ownership.

capabilities.name: Company Engineering Rules
capabilities.intent: Encode organization-specific engineering policies without overriding physical truth or applicable mandatory normative rules.

capabilities.name: Brownfield Reconstruction
capabilities.intent: Reconstruct a trustworthy editable electrical model of an existing installation from partial legacy evidence and field survey data.

capabilities.name: Explainable Engineering Copilot
capabilities.intent: Provide natural-language query, explanation and orchestration while deterministic engineering kernels remain the calculation authority.

capabilities.name: Smart Room Electrical Layout
capabilities.intent: Generate editable geometry-aware layouts for lighting, sockets, switches and related room electrical devices using subtle guide axes, openings, room semantics and deterministic placement rules.

marketValidationQuestions: Does it save measurable engineering time?
Does it catch or prevent costly errors?
Do users repeatedly invoke it on real projects?
Would users pay or upgrade for it?
Does it preserve or increase professional trust?
